landing.heroSubtitle: Circl is the private way to find people around you, send a request, and talk in a space that stays yours.
landing.ageNote: By joining you confirm you are 18 or older.
landing.pillar1Body: Your exact location never shows and your profile stays redacted until you choose to connect.
landing.pillar2Body: No one sees you online, messages you, or reaches your details without an accepted request.
landing.pillar3Body: Fast, secure chat with no phone number to hand over and nothing to overshare.
landing.stepsTitle: Three steps from nearby to known.
landing.step1Body: See who is around you in Browse and Nearby, sorted the way you want.
landing.step2Body: Send a contact request. They accept, or they do not. No pressure, no spam.
landing.step3Body: Talk one to one or in a group, share private albums, meet in public rooms.
landing.privacyTitle: Privacy is not a setting here. It is the foundation.
landing.privacyBody: Most apps ask you to trust them. Circl is built so you do not have to.
landing.privacyPoint1: Presence is shown only to people you have accepted.
landing.privacyPoint2: Public profiles hide your birth date, email, and exact location.
landing.privacyPoint3: Adults-only community with active moderation and easy reporting.
landing.privacyPoint4: Leave whenever you want and take your data with you.
landing.roomsTitle: Curious? Step into a public room first.
landing.roomsBody: Pick a nickname, confirm you are an adult, and join the conversation. Sign up later, when it feels right.
landing.finalTitle: Your circle is closer than you think.
landing.finalBody: Join the people meeting privately on Circl today.
